```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

##extracted data from Figure 2 of Gellrich et al. (2022). 
```{r}
Gellrich_data <- read.csv("M:/Rudolph/Manuscripts and Publications/Paper - Charging Dataset/gellrich_extracted_data.csv")

ggplot(Gellrich_data, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = Day, group = Day)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
Gellrich_data2 <- read.csv("M:/Rudolph/Manuscripts and Publications/Paper - Charging Dataset/Paper_Charging_Infrastructure_PSI/figure_02_data.csv")

# two-letter day code -> full name (explicit lookup, locale-independent)
wd_map <- c(MO = "Monday",   TU = "Tuesday", WE = "Wednesday", TH = "Thursday",
            FR = "Friday",   SA = "Saturday", SU = "Sunday")

Gellrich_data2_formatted <- Gellrich_data2 %>%
  rename(weekday = Weekday,
         utilization = Occupied_Pct) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- weekday -------------------------------------------------------
    weekday = unname(wd_map[weekday]),
    weekday = factor(weekday,
                     levels = c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday",
                                "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")),

    # --- weekday_type --------------------------------------------------
    weekday_type = if_else(weekday %in% c("Saturday", "Sunday"),
                           "Weekend", "Weekday"),
    weekday_type = factor(weekday_type, levels = c("Weekday", "Weekend")),

    # --- split DayHour ("2021-09-01-00") -------------------------------
    date  = as.POSIXct(substr(DayHour, 1, 10), format = "%Y-%m-%d", tz = "UTC"),
    hour  = as.integer(substr(DayHour, 12, 13)),
    month = factor(month.name[as.integer(substr(DayHour, 6, 7))],
                   levels = c("September", "October", "December")),

    # --- week 1-5 ------------------------------------------------------
    week = case_when(
      between(date, as.POSIXct("2021-09-01", tz = "UTC"),
                    as.POSIXct("2021-09-07", tz = "UTC")) ~ 1L,
      between(date, as.POSIXct("2021-09-08", tz = "UTC"),
                    as.POSIXct("2021-09-14", tz = "UTC")) ~ 2L,
      between(date, as.POSIXct("2021-10-18", tz = "UTC"),
                    as.POSIXct("2021-10-24", tz = "UTC")) ~ 3L,
      between(date, as.POSIXct("2021-12-09", tz = "UTC"),
                    as.POSIXct("2021-12-15", tz = "UTC")) ~ 4L,
      between(date, as.POSIXct("2021-12-16", tz = "UTC"),
                    as.POSIXct("2021-12-22", tz = "UTC")) ~ 5L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  )
# ##Checks
# # 1. every row should land in a week; expect 0
# sum(is.na(Gellrich_data2_formatted$week))
# 
# # 2. supplied weekday vs. weekday derived from the parsed date; expect TRUE
# all(as.integer(Gellrich_data2_formatted$weekday) ==
#     as.integer(format(Gellrich_data2_formatted$date, "%u")))
# 
# # 3. row count per week (expect 168 = 7 days x 24 h, one week short by 1)
# table(Gellrich_data2_formatted$week, useNA = "ifany")
# 
# # 4. coverage
# table(Gellrich_data2_formatted$month, Gellrich_data2$weekday_type)
```


```{r}
Gellrich_data_formatted <- Gellrich_data %>%
  transmute(hour = X %% 24,
            week = 1 + (X %/% 24), 
            month = case_match(week,
                               1 ~ "September",
                               2 ~ "September", 
                               3 ~ "October",
                               4 ~ "December",
                               5 ~ "December"),
            utilization = Y,
            day = Day,
            weekday_type = case_match(day,
                                      c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday") ~ "Weekday",
                                      c("Saturday","Sunday") ~ "Weekend"))

# Gellrich_data_formatted

# ggplot(Gellrich_data_formatted, aes(x = hour, y = utilization, color = day, group = month)) +
#   geom_line()

Gellrich_data_formatted$month <- factor(Gellrich_data_formatted$month,
                                        levels = c("September", "October", "December"))
  
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
#Manuscript Figure
ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = Gellrich_data_formatted, 
            aes(x = hour, y = utilization/100,
                group = interaction(week, day, weekday_type),
                color = weekday_type), alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ month, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  # geom_ribbon(data = september_wk, 
  #             aes(x = hour_rounded, ymax = max_util, ymin = min_util), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  # geom_ribbon(data = september_we, 
  #             aes(x = hour_rounded, ymax = max_util, ymin = min_util), fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,24),
    breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 4),
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x),
    expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Weekday" = "#1B9E77", 
                                "Weekend" = "#D95F02")) +
  labs(title = "Hourly Utilization Rates – Weekdays vs Weekends - Validation",
       subtitle = "All days in September, October, and December",
       x = "Hour of Day",
       y = "Utilization (%)",
       color = "Day Type") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 0.25), xlim = c(0,24)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  

ggsave(filename = "M:/Rudolph/Manuscripts and Publications/Paper - Charging Dataset/Figures/Sep_Oct_Dec-Validation.png", width = 8,height = 8,dpi = 300)

```

```{r september}
Gellrich_data_formatted
september_wk <- Gellrich_data_formatted %>%
  filter(day %in% c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday","Friday"),
         month == "September") %>%
  mutate(hour_rounded = round(hour, 0)) %>%
  group_by(hour_rounded) %>%
  summarise(max_util = max(utilization, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_util = min(utilization, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

september_we <- Gellrich_data_formatted %>%
  filter(day %in% c("Saturday","Sunday"),
         month == "September") %>%
  mutate(hour_rounded = round(hour, 0)) %>%
  group_by(hour_rounded) %>%
  summarise(max_util = max(utilization, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_util = min(utilization, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")

ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = september_wk, aes(x = hour_rounded, ymax = max_util, ymin = min_util), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = september_we, aes(x = hour_rounded, ymax = max_util, ymin = min_util), fill = "orange", alpha = 0.7)
```
